description: This file defines a thread-safe counter class named 'Counter' used for high throughput counting in concurrent environments. It is part of the Orleans project, specifically within the internal caching mechanisms, and is based on the LongAdder class by Doug Lea.

classes.name: Counter
classes.description: A thread-safe counter class suitable for high throughput counting across many concurrent threads, derived from Striped64.

methods.name: Counter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new Counter with an initial sum of zero.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Computes and returns the current total count by summing the base value and the values in the cells.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a specified long value to the counter, handling contention with atomic operations and internal accumulation.
